description_full: NOF Corporation manufactures chemicals in Japan. It operates through Functional Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Medicals and Health, and Chemicals Agents segments. The Functional Chemicals segment offers fatty acids and derivatives, surfactants, ethylene oxide and propylene oxide derivatives, organic peroxides, functional polymers, functional films, petrochemical products, and electronic materials, as well as special anti-metallic blue treatment agents. The Pharmaceuticals, Medicals and Health segment provides edible processed oils and fats, food functional ingredients, health-related products, biocompatible materials, and raw materials for DDS pharmaceutical formulations. The Chemicals Agents segment offers industrial explosives, space-related products, defense-related products, and functional products. It is also involved in logistics, insurance agency, and real estate businesses. NOF Corporation was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

financial_summary: NOF CORP is a mid-cap basic materials business with a $4.0B market cap on $1.6B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +2% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
Returns on capital run at 16% against a 9% cost of capital, a 7-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, with gross margins sitting at 35%.

The business throws off $134M in free cash flow — roughly 8 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, with adequate 0.88× cash conversion.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.
Shareholder yield of 5.0% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 9.3% of the shares.

Trade policy and tariff whiplash — materials producers are first-order casualties of protectionist swings, and margin gets squeezed from both input and output pricing.
